name: DVB-T digital television (signalling)
label: DVB-T
notes: DVB-T terrestrial television, signalling only: the external dvbt-rx (a separate GPL program the operator builds: a small wrapper, not yet published, around the modemdvb receiver of SDRangel, which the install pointer names) locks to one multiplex and reports what it signals about itself: the channel width it locked at (8, 7, 6 and 5 MHz are tried in turn), 2K or 8K carriers, guard interval, constellation, code rate, hierarchy and the cell id when the multiplex sends one (many do not: cell_id is then null). No picture, sound or service names yet. Identify and classify offer the row between 174 and 862 MHz, the broadcast bands DVB-T is used in across regions; a job started by hand runs anywhere. Centre the job on the measured middle of the multiplex with a band that covers it; the capture must be at least as wide. An event comes when lock is gained or lost and every 2 s while locked; locked false means no DVB-T multiplex was found at any width (DVB-T2 is not looked for). offset_hz is the multiplex's carrier offset from the job's centre and clock_ppm the sample clock error, both as the receiver measured them; snr_db is of the equalised cells and falls with multipath.
